description: What positions does a Hyperliquid wallet have open? Its positions right now across native and HIP-3 perps: size, entry and mark price, leverage and unrealized PnL. Use it for 'is this wallet long or short?'. For PnL over time use get_user_pnl_series; for its trading record, get_trader_profile.
name: get_user_state

size.description: Signed size: positive long, negative short

total_position_value.description: Sum of position values in USD

total_realized_pnl.description: Sum of realized PnL in USD

total_unrealized_pnl.description: Sum of unrealized PnL in USD

notice.description: A note from the API: how a market name was read, why data starts later than asked, or a next step such as a free key

title: Wallet positions
